The first line contains integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000) — the number of buttons on the jacket.

The second line contains n integers ai (0 ≤ ai ≤ 1). The number ai = 0 if the i-th button is not fastened. Otherwise ai = 1. Unique token result under retained description; generated qualification and independent oracle/audit outstanding.
